_doc: Library metadata, supplied rather than inferred. 451 entries covering the
WHY THIS MATTERS MORE THAN ITS SIZE:
SUBTYPE names body plans the fitter cannot see. spider 7, beast 2,
avian 2, dragon 1 — the non-humanoid shapes veh.rs forces into two arms
and two legs. Measuring ground contacts never found them because the
SCREENER rejects anything that does not stand up tall, so the whole
category was invisible to every test run so far.
MODES lists 19 models with BOTH robot and alt forms. Those are real
transform references — a fold someone authored, against which foldview's
fitted one can be compared. Grimlock, Shockwave, Soundwave, Megatron,
Ratchet, Jetfire, Ironhide and the Insecticons among them.
FLAGS name six models carrying ANIMATION: `transform_anim` on Fall of
Cybertron Megatron, `idle_anim` on Soundwave, `animated` on four more.
Gait strips have been the blocker for walking and running through this
entire port, and this is the first evidence that authored motion exists
